description:
Gnosis Chain network data in one call.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/chain_fees_digest. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
